recent: INSPACE 近期获得一份价值 RM34.75 million 的装修分包合约，并在 2026 财年第三季度恢复盈利。公司也有一项重大诉讼在进行中。

recent_en: INSPACE recently secured a RM34.75 million renovation subcontract and returned to profitability in Q3 FY2026. The company also has ongoing material litigation.
notable_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary IDPM Builder Sdn. Bhd. secured a RM34.75 million subcontract for renovation and addition works.
Returned to profitability in Q3 FY2026 with a profit before tax of RM0.548 million.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation.
